reason: Embedded C/C++ firmware engineering plugin providing domain-specific skills and agents for code generation, debugging, build analysis, design review, and plan-driven implementation workflows.

summaries.zh: 面向嵌入式 C/C++ 固件开发，提供涵盖 FreeRTOS、Keil 构建、HardFault 分析、状态机和调试方法的代理与技能。
summaries.en: An embedded C/C++ firmware engineering plugin offering agents and skills for FreeRTOS, Keil builds, HardFault analysis, state machines, debugging, and plan-driven implementation.

capabilities: Provides embedded C/C++ firmware development guidance and code generation
Assists with FreeRTOS, interrupts, NVM, state machines, Keil builds, and HardFault analysis
Supports planning, design review, implementation workflows, and compile verification
Injects configured gate text into the first model context step
Reads project files when the user directs the model to use the skills
